text:
Predicates:
MadeBy(x, y) ::: x is made by y.
Game(x) ::: x is a game.
Top10(x) ::: x is in the Top 10 list.
SoldMoreThanMillion(x) ::: x sold more than one million copies.
JapaneseCompany(x) ::: x is a Japanese game company.
Premises:
∀x (Game(x) ∧ Top10(x) → MadeBy(x, y)) ::: All games in the Top 10 list are made by Japanese game companies.
∀x (SoldMoreThanMillion(x) → Top10(x)) ::: If a game sells more than one million copies, then it is in the Top 10 list.
SoldMoreThanMillion(theLegendOfZelda) ::: The Legend of Zelda sold more than one million copies.
Conclusion:
MadeBy(theLegendOfZelda, y) ::: The Legend of Zelda is made by a Japanese game company.
∃x (Game(x) ∧ MadeBy(x, y) ∧ y ∈ {JapaneseCompany}) ::: There exists a Japanese game company that made FIFA 22.
